Five Tips for Organizing Your Pantry

A tidy pantry makes everyday cooking easier and helps you keep track of what you already have on hand.

Group similar items together, such as baking supplies, canned goods, and snacks, so you can find things quickly.

Use clear containers for bulk items like flour, sugar, and rice. This keeps pests out and makes contents easy to see.

Label shelves so everyone in the household knows where things belong and puts them back in the right spot.

Finally, do a quick check every few months and toss anything that has expired or that you no longer use.
